title: Building Better: Avoiding Pitfalls in Developing Language Resources when Data is Scarce

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying NLP researchers and practitioners on the limitations of resources for mid- to low-resource languages, specifically analyzing qualitative and quantitative reports of data scarcity, unrepresentativeness, reliance on translationese, and the problematic overgeneralization of dialects.

Analyzing qualitative survey responses regarding datasets' misalignment with local cultural needs, the imposition of Western standards, and highlighting the use of false cultural generalizations and orientalist demographic classifications in NLP research.

Conducting quantitative and qualitative analysis of survey data on credit attribution, financial compensation, and authorship to evaluate systemic labor exploitation and unequal power dynamics affecting data workers from underrepresented communities.
